assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope accompanied by palpitations, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia.
A 48-hour Holter monitor is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity and guide further management.
The service is medically necessary to evaluate the recurrent syncope documented in the clinical indication note.
The service is consistent with diagnosis codes R55 and I47.1.
The cardiac monitoring appeal is against the PR-204 denial.
